| Severity | Items | Conflict | Recommendation |
|----------|-------|----------|----------------|
| Critical | R1, A2, C4 | R1 requires up to 8 simultaneous requests with no queueing, but A2 and C4 both set parallelism to 2 with a FIFO queue for the remainder. | Raise `num_parallel` (and `OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL`) to 8 and remove the FIFO queue path, or provision additional GPU capacity to support 8 concurrent inferences. |
| Critical | R3, A3, C2 | R3 and A3 mandate per-developer API-token authentication on every request, yet C2 sets `auth: none`, disabling all authentication at the gateway. | Change C2 to `auth: token` (or equivalent) and configure the gateway to validate the per-developer token on each request, matching A3. |
| Critical | R4, A4, C3 | R4 states prompts and completions must never leave the local network, but A4 and C3 route overflow traffic to an external hosted cloud API (`api.cloud-llm.example`). | Remove the `overflow_provider` (C3) and the cloud-overflow logic (A4); instead, reject or shed excess requests locally so no data ever leaves the network. |
| Major | R2, C6 | R2 requires TTFT under 2 000 ms, but C6 sets the SLO to 5 000 ms, allowing responses 2.5× slower than the requirement. | Lower `ttft_slo_ms` in C6 to 2000 (or below) and verify the model/GPU can sustain that latency at the required parallelism. |
| Major | R5, A5, C5 | R5 demands a context window of at least 32 768 tokens, yet A5 and C5 both set `num_ctx` to 16 384, exactly half the minimum. | Increase `num_ctx` (C5) and the corresponding Ollama setting (A5) to ≥ 32768, and confirm the 24 GB GPU has sufficient VRAM for the larger context at the target parallelism. |
